The branch is ready for your review and merge: `worktree/dictation-debug` (6 commits, worktree `C:\Code\lew42\worktrees\dictation-debug`). The landing line and full report are in my task log ([report](/framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/20/session-e00f55c9/sessions-and-tasks/dictation-debug/build/report.md)).

**What the stall was.** I reproduced it headless with a fake mic playing a WAV, Servex stubbed (`ux/Dictate/test/stall.mjs`):
- **One unanswered send blocked everything after it.** Sends to Servex had no time limit, and the mic sends sentences through one queue in order. If Servex never answered one, nothing after it went out and no error appeared. Before: 1 send in 25 s of speech, the bar stuck on "Sending · one moment". After: sends give up after 10 s and say why, the stuck sentence is marked "not sent", and the rest go out (4 sends in the same run).
- **The mic stopped silently when the chat moved** between the page, the dock and the phone sheet. I found this while taking the 1920 shot. Now the newest chat box takes over listening.
- **A failed first sentence vanished** from the chat. Now it stays, marked "not sent".
- **The mic is released on reload:** 1 of 1 tracks stopped.

**What changed:**
- **Debug tab** (replaces Dictation): one live row per layer (mic, Whisper, transcripts, sent to the AI, AI answering), each with the real error. It is routed at `<page>/ai/debug/`, a subpath because a peer path could clash with a real child page, and a reload keeps you on it. Shots: [phone, 390](/framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/20/session-e00f55c9/sessions-and-tasks/dictation-debug/build/shots/debug-390.png) · [1920](/framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/20/session-e00f55c9/sessions-and-tasks/dictation-debug/build/shots/debug-1920.png).
- **Bubbles and deltas:** a repeated line no longer duplicates, a late line lands in time order, and a finished reply stops blinking. The replay test (`test/deltas.mjs`) passes; the live site's old code fails 3 of its checks, showing "One. One. Three. Two.".
- **Errors per module:** a page or browser error is now one line in `failures.jsonl` in the module that broke. That is the file Servex `follow` already delivers, so there is no second system; dictation's own log is [ux/Dictate/failures.jsonl](/framework/ux/Dictate/failures.jsonl). How the global `ai/errors/` folder moves to these per-module logs is in the watcher proposal ([page-watcher.md](/framework/ext/ErrorLog/doc/page-watcher.md)), which is not built.
- **The UI rule** is in [framework/doc/rules.md](/framework/doc/rules.md): anything that can fail tells the user what went wrong.

**Not done or not checked:**
- When no answer comes, the AI row turns red after 60 s, but it can't yet say why the assistants were silent. The next step is a status line from `Servex/agents/Sessions.js`; it's in the report.
- I didn't run `test/new-session.mjs`, because it starts real, paid agents.
- `test/in-place.mjs` fails 4 checks, but the live site's code fails the same 4, so this branch didn't cause them.
- The worktree's `ai/prompts.jsonl` was changed by my stall tests (they wrote fallback lines there) and is left uncommitted on purpose.

**Docs now out of date:** `ext/drawer/doc/tabs.md` and `doc/sheet.md` still call the tab Dictation, and `ext/ErrorLog/doc/design.md` describes only the old day file.
Found the session registry that maps a session id to its peer name (e00f55c9 is `monorepo-b9`). Next I'm checking whether Servex can deliver to that name without spending an LLM turn.
Stopping now. No message was sent to any tab. I'm writing the one-paragraph doc and closing the task.

The proposal is clear. `node Server/text-check.mjs` returned no flags for it, so I didn't rewrite anything. It has four numbered asks, and each one names its files and how to prove it. I logged one "clear" line in `.claude/skills/clarity/flags.jsonl`.

Everything you asked for is done and committed; the branch is ready to merge at `ab7f607ba`. All three proofs pass and the smoke test shows no FAIL.

**Your four items**
1. **Comments:** the two constants in `Mic.js` and `ErrorLog.seen` have their own comments again. The same scripted-edit slip had also hit `Widget.HEADROOM` and `AIPage.HIDDEN`, so I fixed those too (685633636).
2. **Docs:** `tabs.md` and `sheet.md` now say Debug, and ErrorLog's `design.md` describes the per-module `failures.jsonl` (769696ad0).
3. **Merge and checks:** michael/dev merged with no conflicts (e258fc0c5).
   - stall.mjs: 10 of 10, including a new "late" case.
   - deltas.mjs: 6 of 6.
   - debug-tab.mjs: 8 of 8 at 390 and 1920, every row green.
4. **The 10 s limit:** no session verb should take that long. `say` and `new` are synchronous in `Servex/agents/Sessions.js` and answer in milliseconds; the agent spawn inside `say` writes no task folder, and its slow part runs after the answer. Only a blocked Servex goes past 10 s, so I kept the limit and made a slow success safe instead:
   - **Line arrives later:** if Servex's line comes back after the timeout, the same bubble is used, "not sent" comes off and the Sent row turns green.
   - **Line arrives first:** if the line comes back before the POST answers, the timeout counts as sent, so there's no false "not sent" and no fallback copy.
   - **What's left:** a sentence that really timed out still gets a copy in the fallback log, which is a log file, not the session.

**The review's fixes**
- **Times compared as text:** this was the real bug, and it's fixed (515bb5d33). debug-tab.mjs now writes Servex's "-05:00" timestamps. Run against the old `chat.js` (a new `CHAT_JS=` override), it fails with the AI row stuck on amber; with the fix it passes.
- **Backstop timer:** it is now cleared when the send settles. A slow success turns the Sent row back to ok, and the fallback copy is written only when the send really failed.
- **`failures.jsonl`:** it is one string now. The Debug tab says "no failures yet" until the file exists, and the docs mark the link as dev only.
- **Pass-round notes:** 1 and 5 are fixed (682d6642e), and 4 is now an open question in `page-watcher.md`. Every note has an answer in the task log.
- **Not touched:** the VS Code ask (minion-dictate-to-tab owns it) and the phone layout note (you logged it).

**Something outside git touched my worktree:** around 23:40 two uncommitted edits (`chat.js`, `stall.mjs`) went back to their committed state. There was no stash and no reset in the reflog. I redid them and committed them as 63e9c3c65. Since then the worktree's uncommitted `ai/prompts.jsonl` has also gone back to its committed state, so something outside git seems to be resetting files there.
Nothing to pick up after the restart: everything is committed (branch ready to merge at `ab7f607ba`), and I'm waiting for your merge.

My context is too full to do the flicker cleanly, so please start a fresh agent. Point it at [ux/Dictate/doc/debug-tab.md](/framework/ux/Dictate/doc/debug-tab.md) and the headless harnesses in `ux/Dictate/test/` (`stall.mjs`, `deltas.mjs`, `debug-tab.mjs`: fake mic, Servex stubbed), which should make reproducing it quick.

The flicker proposal is clear. `node Server/text-check.mjs` flagged nothing, and the title, the ordered steps and the one-screen report line read cleanly. I logged one "clear" line to `flags.jsonl` and made no rewrites.

The verdict is **fix**: the work itself meets every ask, but two Chat docs are now out of date. The report is in `flicker/review/report.md`.

**Requirements: all met.**
- **Cause:** the words left the draft before the sent bubble existed. A pause emptied the draft, then waited for the clean-up and earlier sends before drawing the bubble. A slow send also wiped the next sentence, and a redraw could put new words before old ones.
- **Fix:** the words are drawn as the sent bubble, in the draft's exact spot, the moment they leave it. The send follows later with the same timestamp. A cleaned text swaps only that one piece.
- **Burst numbers:** they agree. With the clean-up: 2 words gone, 2 explained by the clean-up, 0 moved (before the fix: 22 gone, 3 explained, 4 moved). Without it: 0, 0, 0 (before: 7, 0, 2).
- **Timing:** the Debug tab's Sent row and AI row now show how long each step took.
- **Tests:** the minion's log says `stall.mjs`, `deltas.mjs` and `debug-tab.mjs` all pass, and smoke shows no FAIL. I did not re-run them.
- **Polish items 1–4:** done. The one departure is reasonable: item 3 asked to remove a `.catch` in `post_held`. The minion kept it because another chat's send can throw, and removed only the duplicate write.

**Fixes (two out-of-date docs):**
1. `ext/Chat/doc/Composer-notes.md` doesn't list the new `on_out` hook, and `mic-notes.md`'s `post_held` section doesn't mention `take_out()`. A fresh agent reading them won't learn how sent words reach the screen.
2. `ext/Chat/doc/notes.md:69` still says `patch_piece()` redraws the whole bubble. It now swaps one piece, which is the behaviour the fix depends on.

**Notes:**
- The other chat (`ChatPanel.js`) uses the same composer but isn't wired to the fix yet, so it can still flicker. `doc/flicker.md` records this, but no task was filed for it.
- The words in the new bubble are drawn faded, grey on peach at about 3:1 contrast. They are readable, but lighter than settled text.
- Polish items 4 and 5 in the brief are the same ask written twice; it was done once.

I was given shots of the surfaces page at 400, 1200, 1920 and 3440, plus the minion's own burst and Debug shots. A fresh agent can continue from the task folder alone.
